description: A paused game-design lab for a social-stealth encounter, with a Python rules prototype, browser greybox and Godot vertical slice.
scope_audience: Exploratory game-design work testing whether preparation, witnesses and social pressure can resolve one tense encounter; the 6–8 hour game is only a conditional long-term target.

creativity.reason: Two distinct narratives of the same event plus preparation-driven escape/concession paths are an interesting design thesis; global originality is unknown.

current_usefulness.reason: A rules model and layered playable prototypes are reported, but no external playtest or fresh gameplay inspection supports fun or usability claims.

expected_usefulness.reason: If the compact encounter scope succeeds, it can test a concrete alternative to combat-first resolution for its intended player; production-game value is not assumed.

impl_progress.reason: Rules code and three implementation/evaluation layers exist, with routes encoded in the prototype; current slice acceptance and runtime behavior remain unverified.

presentability.reason: README provides concept, non-goals, entry commands and screenshot references and candidly says it is unfinished; visual/gameplay quality was not reviewed.

verification: README, prototype guide and representative event rules inspected; no unit tests, Godot run, browser play, external playtest or image review.

evidence.locator: In 30 seconds; What is here; Goals and non-goals

contribution: The prototype makes consequences legible as public-proof concession, private intimidation, controlled escape or violent dominance; the source supports a design experiment, not a validated game experience.
alternatives_question: Which current social-stealth games offer the same preparation-and-witness consequences, and what first-time play test would show this encounter is distinct and legible?

delivery_likelihood.reason: The project is paused indefinitely and its next gate explicitly awaits owner acceptance; no external validation is claimed.

next_step: Resume only through the owner's stated acceptance gate and obtain a first-time playability review before making a showcase claim.
